whatIsSection.title: What Is Company Name Registration?
paragraphs: Company Name Registration in Dubai (also called Trade Name Reservation) is the official process of reserving a unique business name with the Department of Economic Development (DED) or a Free Zone authority.
It is the first mandatory step in setting up a UAE company — you cannot apply for a trade license without a reserved name.
At Setup Zone Dubai, we provide free name availability checks, brandable name suggestions, compliance verification, and full application filing — typically resulting in approval within 24 hours.

namingRulesSection.title: What's Allowed & Prohibited
namingRulesSection.subtitle: Know the rules before you choose your business name.

allowedItems.title: Unique & Available
allowedItems.description: Your chosen name must not be identical or similar to an existing registered trade name in the UAE.

allowedItems.title: Reflect Business Activity
allowedItems.description: The name should reasonably relate to your business activity — e.g., "Trading" for a trade license.

allowedItems.title: UAE Naming Conventions
allowedItems.description: Must follow UAE naming conventions — no offensive, religious, political, or restricted words.

allowedItems.title: Legal Structure Suffix
allowedItems.description: The name should include the correct legal structure — LLC, FZE, FZCO, or Sole Establishment.

prohibitedItems.title: No Religious References
prohibitedItems.description: Names with references to God, religion, or religious figures are strictly prohibited.

prohibitedItems.title: No Political Names
prohibitedItems.description: Political party names, government references, and political figures are not allowed.

prohibitedItems.title: No Trademark Conflicts
prohibitedItems.description: Names identical to registered trademarks — local or international — will be rejected.

prohibitedItems.title: No Restricted Words
prohibitedItems.description: Words like "bank", "insurance", "university", and country names require special approval or are banned.

items.q: What are the rules for choosing a company name in Dubai?
items.a: Your name must be unique, not similar to existing trade names, reflect your business activity, follow UAE naming conventions, and include the correct legal structure suffix. No religious, political, or restricted words are allowed.

items.q: How many name options should I submit?
items.a: You should submit 3 proposed names in order of preference. If your first choice is rejected, the authority checks the next option — saving time and multiple applications.

items.q: How long does name approval take?
items.a: Typically 24-48 hours depending on the authority. Some Free Zones process name approvals within hours with our priority network.

items.q: How long is a reserved name valid?
items.a: A Trade Name Reservation Certificate is typically valid for 6 months, allowing you to complete your license application during that period.

items.q: What happens if my name is rejected?
items.a: If your first choice is rejected, we resubmit your next option without extra fees (in most cases). We also help you brainstorm alternatives if all 3 are rejected.

items.q: Can I change my company name after registration?
items.a: Yes. You can apply for a name change after registration with the relevant authority — we handle the entire process including updating your license and documents.

items.q: Can I use a foreign name for my UAE company?
items.a: Yes. Foreign-sounding names are allowed as long as they comply with UAE naming rules, don't conflict with trademarks, and don't include restricted words.

items.q: Do I need to have a name before registering a company?
items.a: Yes. Name reservation is the first step before license application in both Mainland and Free Zone jurisdictions.

items.q: Are there any words banned in company names?
items.a: Yes. Words like "bank", "insurance", "university", "God", "Allah", country names, political references, and registered trademarks are restricted or banned.

items.q: How can Setup Zone Dubai help with company name registration?
items.a: We provide free name availability checks, brandable name suggestions, compliance verification, application filing, and follow-up with authorities. Typically, you get approval within 24 hours.
